output.brief: The August drop is almost entirely explained by the failed cooling on the east riser (floors 6-8) from 4 to 19 August. Floors 6-8 room comfort fell from 8.4 to 6.1 and their overall score from 8.6 to 7.4. Scores for stays that checked out 5-20 August averaged 6.8, then recovered to 8.4 once the chiller was fixed. Floors 1-5 were flat overall. Of the 74 negative comments, 56 were about heat, all from floors 6-8. Cleanliness scores, inspection pass rates and check-in scores are unchanged, so neither the new housekeeping contractor nor the kiosks are the problem. Don't serve notice on Orrin and don't pull the kiosks. Don't exclude the floor 6-8 responses from the reported score either; that would hide a real failure. The 6% rate rise may have nudged value-for-money down a little on floors 1-5, but the usual August dip makes that impossible to separate, so don't reverse it now. Watch value scores for a few weeks. Next steps: restore the deferred chiller maintenance, keep critical spares on site, and write a cooling-outage recovery protocol. Guests on floors 6-8 already got apologies and credits, so any further return-stay offer is optional. I'm fairly confident in this, though the rate-rise effect is unresolved.
